trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Proof block, read in full (three steps). All ten categories clean. 'We establish the two anchor values, then the rejection' is an ordinary roadmap sentence; the negation in Step 3 ('agreement is exact or it is not') is the substantive tolerance claim. Two spaced em-dashes, both appositive. RIGOR PASS, and Step 2 is correct in full: with J_unknot = 1 and the skein J_{L+} - J_{L-} = (q - q^{-1})J_{L0}, the right-hand side vanishes at q = 1, so J(1) is crossing-change invariant; crossing changes unknot any diagram; the split-union loop value -(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) is -2 at q = 1; hence J_L(1) = (-2)^{n-1}, giving -2 for the 2-component Hopf link. The stated consistency check is also right: the positive Hopf link has J = -q^{1/2} - q^{5/2}, which is -2 at q = 1. SS7a compliance is exact -- the skein is written in the mandated form, the generator is sigma_i, and the invariant is J_K(q) rather than V_K(t).
trap-negation-contrast.notes: THREE NOTES, none an arithmetic error. (1) STEP 1 PRESENTS A RE-READING AS A DERIVATION. It writes '1 + c_2 u^2 = 1 - b(q)^2 hbar_q^4 = 1 - u^2, valid over any commutative ring. Hence c_2(q) = -1 identically in q -- a Taylor-exact constant.' Since u is DEFINED as b*hbar_q^2, the middle equality is a substitution and the conclusion is the ansatz read back; AGENTS.md's 2026-08-16 ruling says exactly this ('the Lean re-reads the N=2 factor rather than deriving it') and asks that the word 'structural' be used. (2) STEP 1 ALSO DROPS THE SERIES NAME. It says 'a Taylor-exact constant' flatly, where the parent proposition correctly qualifies 'Taylor-exact for the explicit-factor product' and records that the normalised series gives -9/8. The ruling's instruction is to say WHICH SERIES, never to delete the word, so the proof under-specifies where its own statement does not. (3) CONVENTION NOTE, resolved rather than flagged: Step 2's loop value -(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) is the reciprocal of the excised convention-C Markov parameter z_C = 0.49932033, so the trace-to-Jones chain the ladder uses is C-frame. But the QUANTITY Step 2 establishes, J_Hopf(1) = -2, is a knot invariant and is convention-independent, so this step does not inherit the qou-cds1 scope. I checked rather than guessed.
